65853-the-driver.creator: Garet Garrett
65853-the-driver.description: A book by Garet Garrett. rangers mingle their feet gregariously. There are spasmodic sounds of laughter, retort, argument and ribaldry; and continually the shrill cries of youth in a frenzy of expectation. Buggies, two-wheelers, open carts and spring wagons line both sides of the street. The horses are blanketed. A damp, chill wind is blowing.

arxiv-2012-02586.title: TrollHunter [Evader]: Automated Detection [Evasion] of Twitter Trolls During the COVID-19 Pandemic CCS: Security and privacy Social network security and privacy CCS: Computing methodologies Dynamic programming for Markov decision processes CCS: Security and privacy Malware and its mitigation
arxiv-2012-02586.creator: Peter Jachim, Filipo Sharevski, Paige Treebridge
arxiv-2012-02586.description: Abstract . This paper presents TrollHunter , an automated reasoning mechanism we used to hunt for trolls on Twitter during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. Trolls, poised to disrupt the online discourse and spread disinformation, quickly seized the absence of a credible response to COVID-19 and created a COVID-19 infodemic by promulgating dubious content on Twitter.

arxiv-2101-04523.title: On the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili hierarchy in an extended class of formal pseudo-differential operators
arxiv-2101-04523.creator: Jean-Pierre Magnot 1, Vladimir Roubtsov 2,3,4
arxiv-2101-04523.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jean-Pierre Magnot 1, Vladimir Roubtsov 2,3,4. We study the existence and uniqueness of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) hierarchy solutions in the algebra of ℱ ​ C ​ l ​ ( S 1 , 𝕂 n ) \mathcal{F}Cl(S^{1},\mathbb{K}^{n}) of formal classical pseudo-differential operators. The classical algebra Ψ ​ D ​ O ​ ( S 1 , 𝕂 n ) \Psi DO(S^{1},\mathbb{K}^{n}) where the KP hierarchy is well-known appears as a subalgebra of ℱ ​ C ​ l ​ ( S 1 , 𝕂 n ) .

arxiv-2103-13525.title: Expectation-Maximization Learning for Wireless Channel Modeling of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2103-13525.creator: José David Vega Sánchez, Luis Urquiza-Aguiar, Martha Cecilia Paredes Paredes, F. Javier López-Martínez
arxiv-2103-13525.description: Abstract Channel modeling is a critical issue when designing or evaluating the performance of reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted communications. Inspired by the promising potential of learning-based methods for characterizing the radio environment, we present a general approach to model the RIS end-to-end equivalent channel using the unsupervised expectation-maximization (EM) learning algorithm.

arxiv-2107-03641.title: The impact of nasal adhesions on airflow and mucosal cooling - a computational fluid dynamics analysis Journal: Respiratory Physiology & Neurobiology
arxiv-2107-03641.creator: Praween Senanayake, Hana Salati, Eugene Wong, Kimberley Bradshaw, Yidan Shang, Narinder Singh, Kiao Inthavong
arxiv-2107-03641.description: Abstract Nasal adhesions are a known postoperative complication following surgical procedures for nasal airway obstruction (NAO); and are a common cause of surgical failure, with patients often reporting significant NAO, despite relatively minor adhesion size. Division of such nasal adhesions often provides much greater relief than anticipated, based on the minimal reduction in cross-sectional area associated with the adhesion.

arxiv-2303-04097.title: On additive differential probabilities of the composition of bitwise exclusive-or and a bit rotation
arxiv-2303-04097.creator: Nikolay Kolomeec, Ivan Sutormin, Denis Bykov
arxiv-2303-04097.description: Abstract Properties of the additive differential probability adp XR \mathrm{adp}^{\mathrm{XR}} of the composition of bitwise XOR and a bit rotation are investigated, where the differences are expressed using addition modulo 2 n 2^{n} . This composition is widely used in ARX constructions consisting of additions modulo 2 n 2^{n} , bit rotations and bitwise XORs.

arxiv-2407-09145.title: Disentangling SMEFT and UV contributions in h → Z ​ γ h\to Z\gamma and h → γ ​ γ h\to\gamma\gamma decays
arxiv-2407-09145.creator: Kostas Mantzaropoulos
arxiv-2407-09145.description: Abstract LHC searches have revealed that the Higgs boson decay to a photon pair is nearly consistent with the Standard Model (SM), whereas recently, there is evidence for the decay of the Higgs boson to a Z Z -boson and a photon.

arxiv-2412-19177.title: Physical nature of quasi-stable structures existing in antimony melt
arxiv-2412-19177.creator: Artem A. Tsygankov, Bulat N. Galimzyanov, Anatolii V. Mokshin
arxiv-2412-19177.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Artem A. Tsygankov, Bulat N. Galimzyanov, Anatolii V. Mokshin. Equilibrium antimony melt near the melting temperature is characterised by structural features that are not present in simple single-component liquids. The cause of these features may be long-lived structural formations that are not yet fully understood. The present work provides the detailed characterization of the structures formed in liquid antimony near the melting temperature based on the results of quantum chemical calculations and the available neutron and X-ray diffraction data.

arxiv-2502-08102.title: Resampling Methods that Generate Time Series Data to Enable Sensitivity and Model Analysis in Energy Modeling
arxiv-2502-08102.creator: Kelly Wang, Steven O. Kimbrough
arxiv-2502-08102.description: Abstract Energy systems modeling frequently relies on time series data, whether observed or forecast. This is particularly the case, for example, in capacity planning models that use hourly production and load data forecast to occur over the coming several decades. This paper addresses the attendant problem of performing sensitivity, robustness, and other post-solution analyses using time series data.

arxiv-2512-15165.title: Control of kinetic opinion dynamics in popularity-adaptive social networks
arxiv-2512-15165.creator: Giacomo Albi, Elisa Calzola, Matteo Piu
arxiv-2512-15165.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Giacomo Albi, Elisa Calzola, Matteo Piu. This paper presents a mathematical model for opinion dynamics in popularity-adaptive social networks, where both opinion spreading and the evolution of social media contacts depend on agents’ popularity and the prominence of their views. While previous approaches accounted for the influence of popularity on opinion dynamics, we introduce a novel feedback mechanism in which opinion affects the formation of contacts.

pmc-11417706.title: Anterograde Intramedullary Nailing without Bone Grafting for Humeral Shaft Nonunion Associated with Early Exploration of Secondary Radial Nerve Palsy: A Case Report
pmc-11417706.creator: Dan Viorel Nistor, Răzvan Marian Melinte, Romana von Mengershausen
pmc-11417706.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Humeral shaft fractures are relatively common. Complications associated with this type of fracture and its treatment include nonunion and radial nerve palsy. Plate osteosynthesis with autologous bone grafting is considered the gold standard for treating nonunion. However, bone grafts might not always be necessary in cases of hypertrophic nonunion, and treatment should be tailored to the specific type and characteristics of the nonunion.

pmc-11528408.title: Skeletal Editing of Mechanically Interlocked Molecules: Nitrogen Atom Deletion from Crown Ether-Dibenzylammonium Rotaxanes
pmc-11528408.creator: Maxime Gauthier, Jessica B. M. Whittingham, Avantika Hasija, Daniel J. Tetlow, David A. Leigh
pmc-11528408.description: Removing the nitrogen atom from secondary amines while simultaneously linking the remaining fragments is a powerful form of late-stage skeletal editing. Here, we report its use for the deletion of the nitrogen atom of the dibenzylammonium template used to assemble crown ether rotaxanes.

pmc-11668500.title: New York State Climate Impacts Assessment Chapter 02: New York State's Changing Climate
pmc-11668500.creator: Christopher Lamie, Daniel Bader, Kathryn Graziano, Radley Horton, Kecil John, Natalie O'Hern, Sophia Spungin, Amanda Stevens
pmc-11668500.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Many fundamental aspects of New York State's climate have already begun to change, and the changes are projected to continue—and in some cases, accelerate—throughout the 21st century. This chapter explores observed and projected changes in a variety of physical variables that relate directly to weather and climate, starting with average and extreme air temperature and proceeding to the associated effects on precipitation, extreme events, and core properties of New York's coastal and inland waters.

pmc-12333805.title: B cells expressing mutated IGHV1-69–encoded antigen receptors related to virus neutralization show lymphoma-like transcriptomes in patients with chronic HCV infection
pmc-12333805.creator: Christoph Schultheiß, Edith Willscher, Lisa Paschold, Christin Ackermann, Moritz Escher, Rebekka Scholz, Maximilian Knapp, Jana Lützkendorf, Lutz P. Müller, Julian Schulze zur Wiesch, Mascha Binder
pmc-12333805.description: Background:Chronic HCV infection leads to a complex interplay with adaptive immune cells that may result in B cell dyscrasias like cryoglobulinemia or lymphoma. While direct-acting antiviral therapy has decreased the incidence of severe liver damage, its effect on extrahepatic HCV manifestations such as B cell dyscrasias is still unclear.

pmc-12517250.title: Why Forensic Pathologists Maintain Uncertainty in Reporting Causes of Death: How Communicative Uncertainty Devices Shape Reasoning
pmc-12517250.creator: Mikaela Sundberg
pmc-12517250.description: This paper examines how forensic pathologists in Sweden understand and reason around how to communicate the un/certainty of cause of death, given their position to other actors. The paper explores uncertainty work related to the understanding and reasoning on how to use a degree of certainty scale.

pmc-12712053.title: Molecular characterisation of Toxoplasma gondii Mre11 reveals unique structural features and potential as a therapeutic target
pmc-12712053.creator: Diego M Ruiz, Valeria R Turowski, William J Sullivan, Sergio O Angel
pmc-12712053.description: The Mre11 enzyme plays a central role in essential cellular processes such as DNA repair and meiosis, where its endonuclease and exonuclease activities are critical for maintaining genomic stability. Previous studies have linked Mre11 to cell cycle regulation and cancer progression; however, knowledge about DNA processing mechanisms in medically relevant protozoan parasites remains limited.

pmc-12780191.title: The ADMA–NO–NOX2 axis and its association with leptomeningeal collateral impairment in acute ischemic stroke
pmc-12780191.creator: Manuela De Michele, Angela Risitano, Marta Iacobucci, Paolo Amisano, Irene Berto, R Carnevale, V Cammisotto, Angela Pascariello, Matteo Beccia, Antonio Ciacciarelli, Ettore Nicolini, Danilo Toni, Svetlana Lorenzano
pmc-12780191.description: Leptomeningeal collateral (LMC) circulation helps preserve brain tissue during acute ischemic stroke (AIS), with poor collateral status predicting worse outcomes. This study assessed the association between asymmetric dimethylarginine (ADMA), LMCs, infarct volume, and oxidative stress in 101 AIS patients with large vessel occlusion within 6 h or wake-up stroke.

pmc-12789725.title: A sensitive and specific non-invasive urine biomarker panel for prostate cancer detection
pmc-12789725.creator: Menglang Yuan, Marcio Covas Moschovas, Kandarp Joshi, Yohei Sanada, Roshane A Perera, Bongyong Lee, Rudramani Pokhrel, Jiri Polivka, Alexandra Miller, Ernest K Amankwah, Ignacio Gonzalez-Gomez, Naren Nimmagadda, Ezra Baraban, Anant Jaiswal, Cuncong Zhong, Inoel Rivera, Guru P Sonpavde, Chetan Betteg
pmc-12789725.description: SummaryBackgroundProstate cancer (PCa) is one of the leading causes of cancer death in men. While prostate-specific antigen (PSA) testing is widely used for screening, its diagnostic accuracy is limited, often failing to distinguish between benign and malignant prostate conditions, underscoring the need for novel biomarkers with improved diagnostic performance.

pmc-13135611.title: Peganum harmala leaf extract mediated green synthesised polyvinyl alcohol zinc oxide beta cyclodextrin nanocomposite for anticancer and antimicrobial applications
pmc-13135611.creator: Abdulrahman Alasmari, Chellasamy Panneerselvam
pmc-13135611.description: The present study describes the eco-friendly synthesis and multifunctional investigation of a Peganum harmala leaf extract–mediated PVA/ZnO@β-CD nanocomposite. pmc-13459009.title: Efficacy of dihydroartemisinin–piperaquine to prevent malaria and complication-related malaria during pregnancy compared to sulfadoxine–pyrimethamine: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and meta-regression
pmc-13459009.creator: Artha Maressa Theodora Simanjuntak, Frengki Prabowo Saputro Wijayanto, Randika Taufiq Hari Nugraha, Firman Hanif Prathama, Roy Novri Ramadhan, Taufik Mulya Perdana, Jonathan Hasian Haposan, Annisa Dewi Nugrahani, Yovita Hartantri, Sidik Maulana
